title: ESPP Calculator
description: Estimate employee stock purchase plan gains with discount and lookback price.
howto: Enter the fair market value at the offering date and at the purchase date.
Enter your plan discount % and total contribution for the period.
The purchase price uses the lower of the two FMVs (lookback) minus the discount.
Read shares bought, market value, gain, and return %.

faqs.a: Many ESPPs price shares using the lower of the FMV at the offering date or the purchase date, before applying the discount. This tool models that.
Holding the shares long enough (generally 2 years from offering and 1 year from purchase) can change how the discount is taxed. The gain math here is the same either way.
The discount and lookback cushion losses. If the purchase-date FMV is below the discounted price, most plans let you withdraw instead of buying.
